The Democratic Republic of Suzuharu, commonly shortened to the DRC of Suzuharu or Suzuharu is a country located mostly in (CONTINET NAME) with one overseas territory the Isle of Yahui on (CONTINET NAME). Suzuharu shares borders with the Vinterholmian Chaonise, the Imperial Dynasty of Saochai, the Nijian Kingdom, the Republic of Shangra-Li, and the Yaozhou Republic. Also a maritime border with the Federated Sydicates of Veszprem. It borders the Gifu Gulf to the North-East, the (SEA TO OUR NORTH WEST) to the North-West, and the Suzu Sea to the South-West. The Democratic Republic of Suzuharu spans approximately (AREA), with a population exceeding 100 million. This is divided into fifteen administrative divisions and one territory. Suzuharu is a Parliamentary Republic, it's capital Penghu is the cultural hub and the third largest city. The head of state is the president, currently Mrs. President Yi Mei, the head of government is the prime minster, currently Mr. Prime Minster Lei Chin.
